<Heading

>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/tasks/{id}/complete"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Finishes the task's lifecycle (Claimed -&gt; Completed) and publishes `TaskCompleted`. Only the owning station's claim may complete it, and a completed task can never be completed again — this endpoint enforces the no-double-complete invariant, returning `409` on a repeat call rather than silently succeeding twice.
